newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Galore Group suffered in second half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Galore Group suffered in second half.

text.p: Barbecue equipment supplier Galore Group Ltd said on Thursday that while its first half result had been satisfactory, trading in the second half was hit by a slow-down in consumer spending which put pressure on margins.
The company earlier reported a 49.4 percent drop in net profit to A$1.87 million for the year to June 30.
Galore said despite extremely difficult retail conditions, its retail store sales had increased by 8.3 percent over the previous year.
However, the company said its licensee division had traded below the previous year and its wholesale division had traded below expectations due to an extremely competitive environment.
Galore shares closed 2.5 cents higher at 36.5 cents on turnover of 367,596 shares.
